fusions.name: Snatch at the Ford
fusions.desc: A snap into the shallows that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 24%).

fusions.name: Wheeling Shoal
fusions.desc: The pack wheels around you as one school, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Each has a 25% chance to turn on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped the Net
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Silver Flicker
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
